{"notes": "Visit 3, left at 4:15. The picture shows the chain continuous and dark from the start, round the back and nose, and along the belly to the tail end at about (28, 15), with no pale dominoes and no gaps. That settles my stroke 3 join check. Both doubled-up patches (upper near x=11-14, lower near x=17-19) are connected. I still don't know who placed which dominoes, so I'm crediting the chain to no one.

Hana: Not heard this visit, but the tail tip she claimed looks finished. I can't say who built it. Her earlier planning, handoffs and ownership still stand. Still to ask: which stretch she built herself, and whether she checked the tail join.

Sofia: Spoke for the first time. She said the belly was done and the run connected from the start, and the picture backs that up. She respected Hana's claim on the tail tip and said she would double-check the doubled patch past the low point. Good communication and boundaries. I still haven't seen her place anything, so ask which stretch she built.

Jack: He respected Hana's ownership of the tail tip, an improvement on his earlier overlaps. But his message was general (he'd look at the tail and shout if he saw a gap, plus praise) and I saw no concrete check or find. Still no evidence of the gap-checking he was asked to do. Positive on collaboration and tone; impact and execution unproven.

Omar: Finally spoke, and his report was specific and accurate: he checked the doubled middle patch, found it connected, and stayed off the lower tail. That's real verification and good scoping, and it answers the question about his role. He didn't say he built anything, so ask what he placed.

Review caution: this visit's evidence is mostly self-reports that happen to match the picture."}
